label: Light Events → PPS
info:
Listens for state_changed on light.caia and light.lyra; POSTs decoded payload to the NUC receiver (location_daemon /lights endpoint). Pattern mirrors the location pipeline.

AFTER IMPORT: bind the events-state node to your existing HA server reference. Update the http-request URL to your NUC's reachable address.
